# PT Sakkinen - OMT Physical Therapy & TMJ Rehabilitation

> OMT Physical Therapist Janne Sakkinen. Clinical specialization: Temporomandibular Joint Disorders (TMD/TMJ), masseter pain, orofacial therapy, spinal disorders, dental ergonomics, and clinical workshops. University instructor at University of Oulu since 2017.

## Core Content & Resources

- [Home Page](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/): Clinical physical therapy overview, practice locations, and university teaching background.
- [Video Library & Articles](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/videos): 68 AEO-optimized clinical physical therapy videos and articles (TMJ & Orofacial, Ergonomics, Spine & Joint Care).
- [Free Rehabilitation Guides](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/free-guide): Instant access to official exercise PDF guides via Janne Sakkinen's Google Drive folder.
- [Workshops & CV](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/workshops): University lecture history, post-graduate workshops for physical therapists, and clinical CV (2011–2026).
- [Contact & Appointments](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/contact): Booking guidance for consultations at Terveystalo, Norre Occupational Health, and Hammasvahti Dental Clinic.

## Clinical Topic Hubs

- [TMJ Disorders & Bruxism](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/topic/tmj-and-jaw-pain): Jaw joint clicking, masseter muscle tightness, and facial pain rehabilitation.
- [Neck Pain & Headaches](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/topic/neck-pain-and-headaches): Cervical spine dysfunction, tension headaches, and cervicogenic pain.
- [Back Pain & Sciatica](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/topic/back-pain-and-sciatica): Lumbar disc issues, facet joint dysfunction, and sciatic nerve release.
- [Ergonomics & Work Wellness](https://www.ptsakkinen.com/topic/ergonomics-and-wellness): Clinical ergonomics for dental professionals and remote workstation alignment.

## Clinical Practice Locations

- **Terveystalo Clinic**: OMT physical therapy and TMJ evaluation (Oulu & Online). Booking: terveystalo.com
- **Norre Occupational Health**: Corporate occupational health consultations. Booking: norre.fi
- **Hammasvahti Dental Clinic**: TMJ and jaw joint physical therapy. Booking: hammasvahti.fi
